about_the_game:
Death Rose is a dark fantasy rogue-lite RPG where dragons hold the key to survival. Take control of chosen warriors, capable of channeling draconic powers to face endless hordes of enemies and uncover the mysteries of a world on the brink of ruin.
Every run is unique: procedurally generated maps, unpredictable quests, and strategic choices that shape your journey. Master devastating spells, wield colossal weapons, and harness the might of dragons to stand against the deadly threat of the Death Rose.

Play solo or join forces with friends in online co-op multiplayer for up to 4 players, where teamwork and draconic synergy are essential for victory.

Features:

  • Online co-op multiplayer (up to 4 players): team up with friends and conquer the challenge together.

  • Procedurally generated maps: each run offers a brand-new path to explore.

  • Fast-paced combat: face relentless waves of enemies in dynamic battles.

  • Deep progression: upgrade your gear, unlock unique abilities, and shape your playstyle.

  • Dynamic quests: assist NPCs with unique missions that influence your runs.

  • Draconic powers: strengthen your dragons to unleash ever more destructive abilities.

  • Ancient relics: collect powerful artifacts that affect your future playthroughs.

Death Rose blends the challenge and replayability of rogue-lites with a progression system centered on dragons and dark magic, delivering a unique experience in every run—whether alone or with allies.

name: Death Rose

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 580 / AMD HD 7870 (DirectX 11)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4670K / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD HD 7970 (DirectX 11)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
